<Preview>
  <goa-modal heading="Confirm application cancellation" open="true">
    Are you sure that you want to cancel your application? This action will permanently cancel your application and delete any information collected.
    <goa-button-group alignment="end" slot="actions">
      <goa-button type="secondary">Back</goa-button>
      <goa-button type="tertiary" variant="destructive">Cancel application</goa-button>
    </goa-button-group>
  </goa-modal>
</Preview>
description: Use descriptive language in content and button text for destructive actions.
